controls.primary: Predict/run, pause/resume, repair, test repair, explain/finish, next challenge or restart lesson
controls.Next member: Cycles members in the design currently in view as an alternative to spatial selection
controls.Section x20: Uses material budget to increase selected member area
controls.Add brace: Drag both colored handles to joints, release to snap, press Add brace again to commit
controls.Undo: Restores the last valid design edit
controls.Earlier/Later: Step through recorded loads, clamped to the shared range during comparison and after completion
controls.Compare: Switch baseline and repair at identical shared loading
controls.Force colors: Toggle force visualization; starts hidden on transfer challenge
controls.More: Opens secondary controls in the same six-slot panel; Main actions returns to the task

implementationNotes: SI core adapted into Assets/Scripts/CAUSEWAY*.ts; display conversion stays separate from solver dimensions and loads
Native Lesson helper renamed from require to assertPhase to avoid Lens asset-scanner dependency detection
Comparison keeps the repair outcome and actual capacity-limit time visible independently of the shared load step

modelBoundaries: Small displacement, linear elastic, pin-jointed axial truss
Stop at first prescribed step meeting calculated capacity
Exclude bending, buckling, fatigue, fracture and nonlinear collapse
Compare up to and including the earliest modeled limit shared by the two designs
Engineering dimensions and loads remain SI; centimeter scaling is presentation only
